question: How many Transfer(address,address,uint256) logs were emitted by 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913 on chain 8453 during the 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block when requested? Count each log once, including zero-value transfers. Answer as a uint256 number of logs.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.

definitions.metric: Count matching logs emitted by the USDC contract only; deduplicate by blockHash, transactionHash and logIndex. Unit is logs. A complete empty log set returns 0.
